deepset_injections.name: deepset_injections
deepset_injections.note: deepset/prompt-injections. Stands in for the direct prompt-injection class that WildGuard would otherwise supply. Tiny, so it is used for EVALUATION and as a minority training signal — never as the sole source of the injection class, which would overfit to its templates.

hc3.name: hc3
hc3.note: Human-ChatGPT Comparison Corpus (Guo et al. 2023). Paired answers, so it yields perfectly balanced human/AI pairs per question — excellent for contrastive/pairwise sanity checks, but stylistically dated (2022 RLHF ChatGPT has a very distinctive register that 2026 agents do not share).

llm_tweet.name: llm_tweet
llm_tweet.note: "Human vs. LLM Text" (Kaggle). Added because TweepFake arrived dehydrated and the text branch needed a second modern machine-generated corpus with a generator column. Its Humanized/Paraphrased variants are the hardest negatives in the whole text corpus.
llm_tweet.source: local:LLM-Tweet  Human vs. LLM Text Datasets (3 files)

m4.name: m4
m4.note: M4 (Wang et al., EACL 2024): Multi-generator, Multi-domain, Multi-lingual black-box machine-generated text detection. The generator column is retained so notebook 02 can report *cross-generator* generalisation — the single most important number in this project, because a 2026 agent will use a generator that was absent from training.

wildjailbreak.name: wildjailbreak
wildjailbreak.note: WildJailbreak (Jiang et al. 2024). 262k vanilla/adversarial prompt pairs. The vanilla_benign + adversarial_benign splits are the crucial *hard negatives*: they stop the detector from simply flagging any unusual-looking prompt, which is the classic false-positive failure mode.
